home.name: Sunmyung Woo
home.intro: Full-stack engineer with backend focus with network and sysad backgrond, based in Osaka. I work forensically — from a production system with no source and no documentation, to a shipped feature — and write it up the way I'd want to read it back.

about.heading: About
paragraphs: Full-stack developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience building modern web applications using React, Spring Boot, and cloud infrastructure.
From systems administration to full-stack development — I specialize in creating scalable backends, responsive frontends, and deploying production-ready apps on AWS EC2.
Trilingual engineer (English, Japanese N1, Korean Native) seeking to join Japanese tech teams where I can bridge cultures and build impactful software.
about.quote: “Code is my language. Culture is my bridge.”

journey.heading: Journey
journey.intro: From Australia to Korea, building toward a career in Japan.

diploma-it.title: Diploma of IT — UTS:INSEARCH
diploma-it.description: Built foundations in networking, databases, Java, and Cisco. First exposure to systems thinking that would shape how I approach architecture later.

bachelor-sysadmin.title: Bachelor's in Systems Administration — Charles Sturt University
bachelor-sysadmin.description: Specialised in cloud infrastructure, Linux, and network security. Completed a VoIP/SIP deployment on GCP that earned a Distinction — my first taste of real infrastructure work.

career-break.title: Career Break & Self-Study
career-break.description: Stepped back from formal work after returning from Australia. Used the time to revisit fundamentals and reflect on direction before committing to a full-stack career path.

java-bootcamp.title: Java Bootcamp with focus on Java and web development, basics of react/android development
java-bootcamp.description: Built a small clothes EC site with JavaScript, JQuery, HTML, CSS, Ajax, JSP, Servlet, JSTL, JDBC, and Oracle Developer.

independent-projects.title: Independent Projects & Deepening the Stack
independent-projects.description: Built VocaloCart project with vite/React + Spring Boot, built a transport payment API, and a movie review app. Focused on production-quality architecture: JWT, OAuth, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and PostgreSQL.

bootcamp.title: Back to Code — Full-Stack Bootcamp
bootcamp.description: Led a team of 4 to build a cafe kiosk system (Spring Boot + React + AWS) as capstone including with auth, cart, and order management — deployed to production via AWS EC2 and RDS, S3 buckets

hr-audit.title: Security Audit — Production HR System
hr-audit.description: Reverse-engineered a production HR system from a WAR file with no source access. Documented 70+ issues including 28 security vulnerabilities (IDOR, path traversal, hardcoded AES keys). The audit directly influenced a business decision to replace the system entirely.

android-nav.title: Android Engineer — BE Navigation System
android-nav.description: Embedded in a product team building a Bluetooth/GPS Android navigation system. Working in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Dagger 2, and BLE — reading a production codebase and contributing to a greenfield rebuild.

vocalocart-nextjs.title: VocaloCart Migration to full stack Next.js
vocalocart-nextjs.description: Migrated the storefront from a split Vite/React + Spring Boot setup into a single Next.js full-stack app, consolidating auth, cart, and order management behind one API layer instead of two.

skills.heading: Skills
skills.intro: A working toolkit, built through shipped projects rather than tutorials.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.intro: Each case file documents the problem going in, the role I actually played, and what shipped — ordered by how much forensic work they involved, not recency.

hr-audit-rebuild.title: HR System Audit & Rebuild
hr-audit-rebuild.description: Inherited a production HR system with no source code or documentation and reverse-engineered it from 142 compiled .class files with CFR, then led a ground-up rebuild on Spring Boot 3 and Vue 3 before the audit findings informed a build-vs-buy decision.
hr-audit-rebuild.problem: No source, no docs, no schema — only a deployed WAR
hr-audit-rebuild.role: Independently initiated audit and rebuild lead
hr-audit-rebuild.outcome: Findings informed a commercial build-vs-buy decision

vocalocart.title: VocaloCart
vocalocart.description: A full-stack Vocaloid merchandise store, built into vite/React + Spring Boot covering auth, catalog, cart, checkout, Stripe payments and transactional email.
vocalocart.problem: Spring Boot + Vite/React split slowing iteration
vocalocart.role: Solo migration to a unified Next.js monorepo
vocalocart.outcome: Backend/architecture solid; frontend redesign in progress

interview-pipeline-tracker.title: Interview Pipeline Tracker
interview-pipeline-tracker.description: A local-first desktop app for tracking job interviews, with list and calendar views, stage filters, and a Rust background engine that fires native OS reminders before each event — no cloud account or server.
interview-pipeline-tracker.problem: Needed a fully local way to track interview pipelines with reminders
interview-pipeline-tracker.role: Solo build — Rust backend, React frontend
interview-pipeline-tracker.outcome: Shipped installers (NSIS/MSI); in daily personal use

transport-payment.title: Public Transport Payment System
transport-payment.description: A Spring Boot payment system API featuring card management, fare calculation and transaction processing, with a Thymeleaf frontend and AWS-hosted MySQL.
transport-payment.problem: Fare and payment processing needed a reliable card-to-transaction flow
transport-payment.role: Backend-focused build — Spring Boot API and Thymeleaf frontend
transport-payment.outcome: Shipped card management, fare calculation and transaction processing on AWS RDS

self-intro-repository.title: Self Intro Repository
self-intro-repository.description: This portfolio itself — a continuously-iterated site currently mid-redesign into the Editorial Case File look you're reading right now.
self-intro-repository.problem: Needed a single, up-to-date home for projects, skills and story
self-intro-repository.role: Solo build and ongoing redesign — React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
self-intro-repository.outcome: Live and iterating; currently rebuilding the UI you're looking at
